dslRule:
<!id: use-standard-charsets-for-bytearrayoutputstream-tostring>
<!description: Replace 'UTF8' string literal encoding with StandardCharsets.UTF_8 constant for ByteArrayOutputStream.toString(). This leverages the 'toString(Charset)' overload introduced in Java 10, which is type-safe and avoids UnsupportedEncodingException.
>
<!severity: WARNING>

$s.toString("UTF8") :: sourceVersionGE(10) && instanceof($s, "java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream")
=> $s.toString(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
;;
summary: Replaces 'UTF8' string literal with `StandardCharsets.UTF_8` for `ByteArrayOutputStream.toString()` when Java 10+ is available.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
